subject: Quick follow-up: fit for Redwood Inference at Olive Apps?
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Mike Thomas <mike@oliveapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Redwood x Olive Apps discovery (May 27)

Hi Mike — great meeting yesterday. Thanks for walking through Olive Apps' latency and cost pain points for in-app suggestions. Short recap and suggested next steps: 

What I heard: 
- Priority: reduce inferencing cost per active session and keep 95th%-ile latency under 120ms for internal A/B tests.
- Data: production traffic is mostly short prompts (avg 80 tokens), occasional long-context batch jobs.
- Compliance: need audit logs + optional private deployment for PII-sensitive flows.

Suggested next step:
1) Quick pilot: 2-week sandbox in our Dedicated tier (isolated GPU pool) to measure real p95 and cost.
2) Technical sync with Ben (solutions engineer) to map KV caching and batching rules.

Attached: short deck that highlights our Dedicated pilot plan and an example success metric dashboard.

If this looks right, would you be open to a 30-min technical sync next week (Ben + me)? I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[t] +1 (415) 555-0122 | [e] tessa.morgan@redwood.com
[Attachment: oliveapps-quick-deck.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Mike Thomas <mike@oliveapps.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood x Olive Apps discovery (May 27)

Thanks Tessa — the pilot flow sounds reasonable. Can you send ballpark pricing for the Dedicated pilot and any hard limits for throughput? Also curious if Redwood can support our SSO + KMS requirements.

— Mike
Mike Thomas
Director of Platform Engineering | Olive Apps

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Mike Thomas <mike@oliveapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood x Olive Apps discovery (May 27)

Hi Mike — appreciate the quick reply. Short answers and an attached CSV with a conservative pilot estimate: 

- Ballpark pricing: Dedicated pilot (2 GPUs, reserved for 2 weeks) — estimated $12,000–$16,000 depending on throughput; includes 24/7 routing and observability. Details in attached pricing-estimate-OLV-039.csv.
- Throughput hard limits: we can guarantee baseline throughput of ~120 tokens/sec per GPU for your avg prompt mix; we’ll size for headroom after the tech sync.
- SSO + KMS: Yes — SAML SSO is supported; KMS integrations are available for Private/Dedicated. We can share our security questionnaire and SOC-2 evidence during procurement.

Next steps I propose:
- Technical sync (30 min) with Ben to confirm throughput assumptions and data flows.
- If that looks good, we’ll spin a sandbox and share p95/cost numbers within 3 business days of ingesting a small traffic sample.

Would Wednesday (June 9) or Thursday (June 10) work for the technical sync?

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-estimate-OLV-039.csv (CSV, 8KB)]

Hi Mike — looping back since I haven't heard about timing for the tech sync or next steps. Wanted to make this super quick: 

- Is reducing per-session inference cost and keeping p95 <120ms still a priority for Olive Apps this quarter? (Yes / No / Lower priority)
- If yes, is a 30-min technical sync next week helpful to validate assumptions and get a sandbox running?

If this isn't a fit, totally fine — a one-line "not a fit" helps us not bug you further.

If helpful, here are two short options you can pick in one click: 
- 15 min: high-level fit check (no Ben) — I’ll share what success looks like.
- 30 min: tech sync (Ben joins) — we size the pilot and confirm security checklist.

Thanks again — happy to adapt to whatever timing works.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
